Trainer! You got a good look at how awesome I am, right?!
Let's call it a day! See you after class tomorrow!

The Voice of Destiny is this incredible voice... that gives me
a push whenever I make a choice!

—...I see.
Take good care of Epi.
Nope, it's never wrong!

Hm? Oh, right.
No one else can hear it right now, can they!

All right! I'll make sure the Voice of Destiny awakens in you too!
Keep your eyes on me, okay?! ...See ya!

Epiphaneia is remarkable. Yet Symboli Kris S, powering through a routine
many times heavier without breaking a sweat, was truly in a league of her own.

I know I can win, and the Voice of Destiny is giving me a push too.
So I'm definitely gonna win. Without a doubt!

Observing her, Epiphaneia exceeds baseline metrics in every single category.
And among them—her power, in particular, was nothing short of breathtaking.

Winning the Nippon Derby, proving herself to the world... while it wasn't anything
so straightforward, she clearly had a dream of her own.

It means I've got two mentors: Cesario and Kris S!
The Voice of Destiny told me these two were the ones, after all!

I know! I'm gonna switch up our training routine, but that's cool with you, right?!
—A match race with Kris S!

Yeah! The Voice of Destiny gave me that push!
It said if I feel you're the one, then it's absolutely right!

Hmm? People always ask me that, but it's hard to explain.
Anyway, whenever the Voice of Destiny approves, things always turn out awesome!

Her abilities, her goals, her dreams... Taking charge of an athlete's vital career
meant there were countless things I needed to learn. In any case, I wanted to talk properly with her.

It's my Trainer!
...Ah, don't worry. There's still another legendary bread left♪

Whew~~...!
—Well, Trainer?! Aren't I awesome?!
...Epi. Who is that Trainer?

Ah, here you are! Kris S, I... am definitely not losing today!
All riiiiight, let's do this!

If I run and keep winning, everyone will get to know me.
They'll watch me and feel destiny at work. And when that happens—

Between Symboli Kris S and Epiphaneia as she is now, the gap
in their levels was simply far too vast. Her chances of winning were virtually nonexistent.

The "Voice" inside everyone else will wake up too, giving them a push forward!
—Just like me! Isn't that the greatest?!

I am strong. I am right!
The Voice of Destiny says so too. That's why—I'll win!

Oh...♡
...U-Umm... okay then, here...?

So, anything else?
Ask me whatever you want!

To be precise, rather than pure muscle strength, it was the explosive force
when her power was directed cleanly that was astounding. I felt that watching her run, too.

And earlier, just when my stomach growled, I heard the Voice of Destiny!
And the one I happened to pick had a "Legendary" sticker on it♪

No, it is, this is totally destiny!
Let's forge the future together. I promise—I'll make you happy!

Hey Kris S, you're training after this, right?
Me too! Let's do it together! You don't mind, right, Trainer?!
Kris S is my master!

As if guided by some powerful force, I answered that I would be her trainer.
...Yes, I committed to it without hesitation.

Whoa?
Oh! Ooooh~~?!

Oh, Trainer! Sorry, did I make you come all the way to pick me up?
Thanks, though!

Epiphaneia blasts past with mind-boggling speed. Her raw momentum
is so breathtaking that my heart starts pounding. Could it be... really—?!

Hey! You get what I'm all about now, right?
Next up, I'll show you what I can really do! Let's start training tomorrow!

She's an ultra-elite competitor who has won back-to-back victories
in prestigious GⅠ races like the year-end Arima Kinen and the historic Tenno Sho (Autumn).

She tears up the steep uphill course effortlessly with her powerful strides.
Epiphaneia's innate talent is—without a doubt—extraordinary.
To bring the Voice of Destiny to everyone!

Good work, everyone!
Kris S, let's grab some food together!

Alright! Then tomorrow after school!
Make sure to decide what we're doing! I'm really looking forward to it!

This is it, right here! Everyone at the school store was talking about it.
They say every once in a while, a super-premium one gets mixed in with the regular yakisoba pan!

—An overflowing surge of confidence. Even knowing
it lacked any real foundation... I was completely overwhelmed.

...To sum it up, Epiphaneia deeply values this "Voice of Destiny" only she can hear,
and that voice seems to play a major role in all her choices.

Nope! But the Voice of Destiny told me I should do it!
Which means I'm gonna win!

Ooh! You're just the person I wanted to see!
Here, this is guaranteed to be delicious—it's the "Legendary Yakisoba Pan," after all!
—I feel destiny in you!
Hmm, hmm, hmm-hmm-hmm♪
—Doryaaaaahhhhhhhh!!!!

Next, I had her do a 200m all-out sprint. She blazed through at a pace
that would easily exhaust most pre-debut racers, and then—

—Don't hold back, take it!
The Voice of Destiny said you should have it too, Kris S!

—I see. So you want to know more about me.
Alright, ask away! The Voice of Destiny says the same thing!

Woooaaahhhhhhhh!!!!
—Yeah, that's right! I'm gonna win, win... win win wiiiiin!

It was completely, utterly different from our original plan... but at Epiphaneia's
insistent request, we ended up holding a joint training session with Symboli Kris S.

The trainer's office during lunch break, got it!
Understood, I'll bring my lunchbox!

After school the next day. I had enthusiastically drawn up a training regimen
and was waiting at the meeting spot, but...
And so, lunchtime—

—Trainer!
I'm already done warming up!
